verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs list ISO 27001 among the frameworks managed in the platform, alongside pre-mapped controls and in-platform auditor collaboration and audit-partner selection. Nothing shows ISO 27001 is handled as a first-class framework rather than a mapped one, and the only detailed launchpad guide is for SOC 2. missing for 10: evidence of the current (2022) Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability generation or management, ISO certification-audit artifacts (e.g. Stage 1/Stage 2 support), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
